```{r Step 0: Pull in ANES Data, include=TRUE}
anes_panel <- read_dta(here("00_rawdata", "ANES_Data", "anes_timeseries_cdf_stata_20260205.dta"))
```

```{r Step 1: Cleaning Up the Dataset, include=TRUE}
# Check the variables
anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  rename(year = VCF0004, trust_gov_index = VCF0656, trust_gov = VCF0604, econ_views = VCF0870, stock_owns = VCF9224, social_class = VCF0149, person_finances = VCF0880, person_finances_scale = VCF0880a, personal_finances_next = VCF0881, age = VCF0101, age_group = VCF0102, gender = VCF0104, race = VCF0105a, educ = VCF0110, income_group = VCF0114, emp_status = VCF0116, homeowner = VCF0146, marital_stat = VCF0147, partisan_id = VCF0301, partisan_strength = VCF0305, pol_interest = VCF0310, union_mem = VCF0127)


#Initial Diagnostics
anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  mutate(
    personal_finances_change = case_when(
      as.numeric(person_finances_scale) %in% 1:5 ~ as.numeric(person_finances_scale),
      as.numeric(person_finances_scale) %in% c(8, 9) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    personal_finances_scale_factor = factor(
      personal_finances_change,
      levels = 1:5,
      labels = c(
        "Much better",
        "Somewhat better",
        "Same",
        "Somewhat worse",
        "Much worse"
      )
    )
  )

anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  mutate(
    personal_finances_scale_clean = case_when(
      as.numeric(person_finances_scale) %in% 1:5 ~
        as.numeric(person_finances_scale),
      as.numeric(person_finances_scale) %in% c(8, 9) ~
        NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  mutate(
    personal_finance_direction = case_when(
      personal_finances_scale_clean %in% c(1, 2) ~ "Better",
      personal_finances_scale_clean == 3 ~ "Same",
      personal_finances_scale_clean %in% c(4, 5) ~ "Worse",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    personal_finance_direction = factor(
      personal_finance_direction,
      levels = c("Better", "Same", "Worse")
    )
  )
#Recoding Variables (Brought Over from Part 1)
anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  mutate(
    trust_gov_index = na_if(trust_gov_index, 999)
  )

#Same Thing for Economic Views
anes_panel %>%
  filter(year >= 2000, year <= 2024) %>%
  count(econ_views, sort = TRUE)

#Recode Data to Only show valid entries
anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  mutate(
    trust_gov_index = na_if(trust_gov_index, 999),
    econ_views = case_when(
      econ_views %in% c(1, 3, 5) ~ econ_views,
      econ_views %in% c(8, 9) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  mutate(
    # Trust
    trust_gov_index = if_else(
      trust_gov_index == 999,
      NA_real_,
      as.numeric(trust_gov_index)
    ),

    # Economic views
    econ_views = case_when(
      as.numeric(econ_views) %in% c(1, 3, 5) ~ as.numeric(econ_views),
      as.numeric(econ_views) %in% c(8, 9) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    # Stock ownership
    stock_owns = case_when(
      as.numeric(stock_owns) == 1 ~ 1,
      as.numeric(stock_owns) == 2 ~ 0,
      as.numeric(stock_owns) %in% c(-8, -9) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    # Homeownership
    homeowner = case_when(
      as.numeric(homeowner) == 1 ~ 1,
      as.numeric(homeowner) == 2 ~ 0,
      as.numeric(homeowner) %in% c(8, 9) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    # Income percentile group
    income_group = as.numeric(income_group)
  )

anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  mutate(
    econ_views_factor = factor(
      econ_views,
      levels = c(1, 3, 5),
      labels = c(
        "Get better",
        "Stay about the same",
        "Get worse"
      )
    ),

    income_group_factor = factor(
      income_group,
      levels = 1:5,
      labels = c(
        "0–16th percentile",
        "17–33rd percentile",
        "34–67th percentile",
        "68–95th percentile",
        "96–100th percentile"
      )
    )
  )

#Adding in new variable - external efficacy index
anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  rename(
    efficacy_index = VCF0648
  )

summary(anes_panel$efficacy_index)

table(
  anes_panel$efficacy_index,
  useNA = "ifany"
)

anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  mutate(
    efficacy_index = case_when(
      as.numeric(efficacy_index) %in% 1:100 ~ as.numeric(efficacy_index),
      as.numeric(efficacy_index) >100 ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) 

anes_panel %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(efficacy_index)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n > 0)

#Turn Dataset into Survey Object
anes_svy <- anes_panel %>%
  filter(year >= 2000) %>%
  as_survey_design(
    ids = 1,
    weights = VCF0009z
  ) 

anes_svy

```

```{r Step 2: Model Relationship Between Personal Financial Views and External Efficacy, include=TRUE}
mod1 <- svyglm(
  efficacy_index ~ personal_finances_scale_clean + factor(year),
  design = subset(
    anes_svy,
    !is.na(efficacy_index) &
    !is.na(personal_finances_scale_clean)
  )
)

summary(mod1)


personal_efficacy_models <- lapply(
  sort(unique(anes_panel$year[
    anes_panel$year >= 2000 & anes_panel$year <= 2024
  ])),
  function(y) {

    data_y <- anes_panel %>%
      filter(
        year == y,
        !is.na(efficacy_index),
        !is.na(personal_finances_scale_clean),
        !is.na(VCF0009z)
      )

    if (nrow(data_y) == 0) return(NULL)

    design_y <- survey::svydesign(
      ids = ~1,
      weights = ~VCF0009z,
      data = data_y
    )

    mod <- survey::svyglm(
      efficacy_index ~ personal_finances_scale_clean,
      design = design_y
    )

    broom::tidy(mod) %>%
      filter(term == "personal_finances_scale_clean") %>%
      mutate(
        year = y,
        n = nrow(data_y)
      )
  }
) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  select(year, n, everything())

personal_efficacy_models
```

```{r Step 3: Modeling This with a Five Category Specification, include=TRUE}
personal_efficacy_factor_models <- lapply(
  sort(unique(anes_panel$year[
    anes_panel$year >= 2000 & anes_panel$year <= 2024
  ])),
  function(y) {

    data_y <- anes_panel %>%
      filter(
        year == y,
        !is.na(efficacy_index),
        !is.na(personal_finances_scale_factor),
        !is.na(VCF0009z)
      )

    if (nrow(data_y) == 0) return(NULL)

    design_y <- survey::svydesign(
      ids = ~1,
      weights = ~VCF0009z,
      data = data_y
    )

    mod <- survey::svyglm(
      efficacy_index ~ personal_finances_scale_factor,
      design = design_y
    )

    list(
      year = y,
      model = mod,
      n = nrow(data_y)
    )
  }
)

personal_efficacy_factor_models
```

```{r Step 4: Three Category Specification, include=TRUE}

  ])),
  function(y) {

    if (nrow(data_y) == 0) return(NULL)

      ids = ~1,
      weights = ~VCF0009z,
      data = data_y
    )

    mod <- survey::svyglm(

)

```

```{r Step 5: Does Income Moderate the Relationship, include=TRUE}
personal_efficacy_income_models <- lapply(
  sort(unique(anes_panel$year[
    anes_panel$year >= 2000 & anes_panel$year <= 2024
  ])),
  function(y) {

    data_y <- anes_panel %>%
      filter(
        year == y,
        !is.na(efficacy_index),
        !is.na(personal_finance_direction),
        !is.na(income_group_factor),
        !is.na(VCF0009z)
      )

    if (nrow(data_y) == 0) return(NULL)

    design_y <- survey::svydesign(
      ids = ~1,
      weights = ~VCF0009z,
      data = data_y
    )

    mod <- survey::svyglm(
      efficacy_index ~
        personal_finance_direction *
        income_group_factor,
      design = design_y
    )

    list(
      year = y,
      model = mod,
      n = nrow(data_y)
    )
  }
)

personal_efficacy_income_models
```
